purpose: Teach: 産婦人科/寝台/かばん/軍用/牡丹/キャラメル/弾丸/アクリル

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママは翔くんを産婦人科で産んだのよ
lines.en: Sho, you know Mama gave birth to you at the ob-gyn, don't you?
lines.style: Gentle, almost conversational recall. Warm nostalgia in the voice. Speaking to herself as much as to him. A soft, measured cadence that holds tenderness without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと寝台列車に乗ってみたい
lines.en: Mom, I want to go on a sleeper train with Dad sometime.
lines.style: Small, hopeful voice. The words tumble out with genuine curiosity, not demanding — more like he's offering her an idea he's been turning over. Open, earnest.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんがかわいいかばんをプレゼントしてくれたわね
lines.en: Sho, Grandma gave you such a pretty little bag, didn't she?
lines.style: Pleased, observant tone. She's noticing a moment of his happiness — not steering him, just acknowledging what she sees. Warm but unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんが古い軍用ヘルメットを持っていらしたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa has this old military helmet he showed me.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact wonder. He's discovered something and wants to tell her about it. Small but certain in his delivery. No rush — just sharing what caught his eye.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんのお庭の牡丹、満開ね
lines.en: Sho, the peonies in Grandpa's garden are in full bloom right now.
lines.style: Observant, almost thinking aloud. She's noticed something beautiful and is offering it to him to see too. Unhurried, peaceful pacing. A moment of quiet pleasure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんからキャラメルもらって嬉しかった
lines.en: Mom, I was really happy when Grandpa gave me that caramel.
lines.style: Soft contentment in his voice. He's not boasting — he's savoring the memory. Simple, genuine pleasure. A small smile lives in the delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが弾丸トラベルで出張なさるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your father's going on one of his business trips on the bullet train.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, slightly informative. She's telling him something practical, but there's a thread of acceptance underneath — she knows this pattern. Steady, unrushed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとアクリル絵の具買いに行きたい
lines.en: Mom, can I go with Dad to get some acrylic paints?
lines.style: Eager but polite, the way a child asks for something he really wants but isn't sure about. A slight lift at the end — hopeful, reaching. Fresh, open.
